maintenance_led.reason: Marketplace earning fees on first-time purchases of handmade and vintage goods; not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying goods and from sellers paying fees, not from government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by expanding its own marketplace; occasional acquisitions like Depop and Elo7 are not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Buyers can easily shop elsewhere; sellers can list on other marketplaces, though they lose their shop's reviews and audience.
